authorization: User explicitly requested stopping current 5+5 experiment and restarting with 4+4; scientific conditions unchanged.
stopping: Original val_rmse best checkpoint, patience12 validations, same original physical-loss warmup and LR schedule
derivative: Centered with two ocean neighbors; first-order one-sided with one ocean neighbor; no derivative across land

normalization.physics_basis: Full train 7644 windows, observed linear endpoints, we=0, P0 resolved RHS, valid660; common across all arms

period_mean: Use same linear temperature path and average raw signed daily residual in K/day before legacy clip10 and common RHS normalization
boundary_limitations: One-sided derivatives have lower order; this is not a flux-conservative ocean solver or a proof of complete coastal boundary conditions
preserved: Original src models, original time splits, all validation/test indices, old Full/subset outputs, original normalization cache
rng: All runs initialize P0-shaped heads identically per seed; gradient diagnostic restores CPU/CUDA RNG; initial parameter/RNG hashes and first128 batch-target hash must match across arms
selection: For each physics family choose lambda among 0/shared matched baseline, .01,.1,.3 by 3-seed mean best validation RMSE; exact ties prefer smaller lambda
primary: Paired SST RMSE: each new physics arm vs matched baseline, period-mean and P1 vs P0 daily at matched lambda and validation-selected settings; every arm reported
references: Old baseline, old aux-only lambda_phys0/rres10 and old P0 lambda_phys.1/rres10 are contextual; changes in auxiliary loss/stencil/scale cannot be attributed to a single cause

uncertainty.limitations: Conditional on fitted models; no new-seed or family-wide significance claim, no equivalence/no-harm claim

interpretation: Exploratory follow-up informed by previous test scores; no new independent test split or automatic favorable-test expansion
restart_policy: Restart all 30 runs from original seeds; preserve partial stopped outputs; no checkpoint resume because original checkpoints omit optimizer/stream/RNG states
